title: A release publishes the moment its before-and-after check passes
why: Jason's ruling, 2026-11-28 15:55 UTC: "Push to live should be done immediately, upon pass." Today's Lives landed on the 10-minute job's runs. The cause, in two parts: beforeafter.yml committed its verdict and told nobody, and the site's ping endpoint (website/api/releases-pull.php) took builds only, leaving verdicts to releases_tick (the CEO's Tier 4 option (a), 2026-11-27, handoffs/pipeline-tick/README.md). His ruling replaces option (a). Gate: the record every gate's work is picked from (Goals and records with the roles, by Mon Nov 30).
